title: Expand first-month support only within a measured cohort
summary: Thirty-day attrition was lower in the illustrative support cohort, at 80 versus 120 of every 1,000 subscribers, but assignment was not randomized. The operating decision is a limited expansion that tracks 90-day retention alongside cost per subscriber.

sections.title: A limited expansion fits the evidence available today
paragraphs: In the support cohort, 80 of every 1,000 enrolled subscribers left within 30 days, compared with 120 in the comparison cohort. That is an observed attrition difference, not a causal estimate, because assignment was not randomized.
First-month cost per subscriber rose from KRW 18,400 to KRW 19,800. Expansion should therefore remain conditional on both 90-day retention and a defined cost ceiling.

Illustrative first-month cost was KRW 18,400 per comparison-cohort subscriber and KRW 19,800 per support-cohort subscriber.

quotations.text: Do not approve a full rollout before the 90-day result is available.

limitations: All numbers are illustrative and exist only to exercise the report contract.
Assignment was not randomized, so the attrition difference is not a causal estimate of support.
Thirty-day observation cannot establish long-term retention or lifetime value.
